status: Local source-masked validation accuracy; original device-resident inference timings

timing.statistic: Median synchronized wall time per batch divided by batch size; range is min/max repeats, not a confidence interval.
timing.scope: Device-resident NISP inputs to physical-intensity outputs. Includes representation conversion, diffusion noise creation and ensemble averaging. Excludes disk IO, host/device transfers, metrics, interpolation validity-mask construction and model loading.

source_mask.rule: Smooth the full signed JWST reference with a normalized Gaussian; estimate median and sigma-clipped standard deviation from valid smoothed pixels at radius 70–95. Detect all 8-connected regions with at least 10 pixels above median + threshold*sigma; fill holes and dilate by a radius-3 disk. Intersect with common validity and crop to the central 105x105 pixels only after detection. Background is the complement within common validity. No per-model masks.

settings.accuracy_intervals: Resample spatial blocks with replacement, retaining all objects and methods paired. Equal object weights within the resulting population. Percentile 95% intervals; conditional on this field, validation selection and trained checkpoints.
